title: The Hungry Cat
content:
A cat is hungry. The cat sees a red apple on the table.
The cat is sad — cats do not eat apples.
Then the cat sees milk in a bowl. The cat is happy!
The cat drinks the milk. The cat is not hungry now.

title: A Day at the Park
content:
On Sunday, my brother and I go to the park.
We see green trees, yellow flowers, and a small lake.
A dog is running. Two birds are singing in a tall tree.
My brother eats a banana. I drink water.
We play, we run, and we are very happy.

title: A Rainy Morning
content:
It is Monday morning. The sky is dark and cloudy.
Then it starts to rain. I take my umbrella and walk to school.
The road is wet. A cat hides under a car.
At school, the teacher smiles. "Good morning!" she says.
Inside the warm classroom, we read a book about the sun.

title: Dinner at the Restaurant
content:
Mom and Dad take me to a new restaurant for dinner.
A waiter brings the menu. I want pizza, but Mom orders chicken soup.
Dad has coffee. I have a cold smoothie.
The food is delicious. We talk and laugh together.
After dinner, Dad pays the bill and says, "Thank you!"

title: Lost in Town
content:
Anna is in a new city. She wants to find the train station.
She sees a kind man. "Excuse me," she says. "Where is the station?"
"Walk straight ahead," he answers, "then turn left at the bank."
"Is it far?" Anna asks. "No, it is near. About ten minutes."
Anna says "Thank you!" and walks happily to the station.

title: My Family
content:
This is my family. I have a mom, a dad, and a little sister.
My mom is kind. My dad is tall.
My sister is small. Her name is Mia.
We live in a small house. I love my family.

title: My Pet Dog
content:
I have a pet dog. His name is Max.
Max is brown and white. He is small but fast.
Max likes to play with a red ball.
Every day, I give Max food and water.
Max is my best friend.

title: My Toys
content:
I have many toys in my room. I have a teddy bear, a red car, and three dolls.
The teddy bear is big and soft. The car is fast.
My favorite toy is the teddy bear. His name is Bobo.
At night, I sleep with Bobo.

title: At the Supermarket
content:
On Saturday, Mom and I go to the supermarket.
We take a big cart. We need milk, bread, apples, and eggs.
I see many people. The shop is big and bright.
Mom pays at the counter. I help carry the bags.
We go home with full bags of food.

title: My School Bag
content:
My school bag is blue. It has many things inside.
There are five books, two pens, and a yellow pencil case.
In the pencil case, I have pencils, an eraser, and a ruler.
I also have a water bottle and a snack.
My bag is heavy, but I like it.

title: Colors and Clothes
content:
Today is cold. I open my closet to choose clothes.
I wear a red sweater and blue jeans.
My white socks are warm. My black shoes are new.
My little brother wears a green shirt and yellow pants.
We look funny but warm.

title: Birthday Party
content:
Yesterday was my birthday. I turned ten years old.
My parents made a big chocolate cake with ten candles.
My friends came to my house with presents.
We played games, ate cake, and danced.
Before blowing the candles, I made a wish.
It was the best day of the year.

title: Morning Routine
content:
Every morning, I wake up at six thirty.
First, I brush my teeth and wash my face.
Then I eat breakfast — usually eggs, toast, and orange juice.
At seven, I put on my uniform and pack my bag.
My dad drives me to school at seven fifteen.
I like my morning routine. It makes me feel ready.

title: At the Doctor
content:
Last week, I had a bad cough. My mom took me to the doctor.
The doctor's name is Doctor Lee. She is friendly and kind.
She looked at my throat and listened to my chest.
"You have a small cold," she said. "Drink hot tea and rest."
She gave me some medicine. After three days, I felt better.

title: A New Friend
content:
On my first day at the new school, I sat alone.
A girl with curly hair smiled at me. "Hi! I'm Lina," she said.
"Hello, I'm Tom. Nice to meet you," I answered.
"Are you new here?" Lina asked.
"Yes, my family just moved here last week."
"Don't worry. I'll show you around," she said.
From that day, Lina became my best friend.

title: Phone Call with Grandma
content:
Every Sunday evening, I call my grandma.
"Hello, Grandma! How are you?" I ask.
"I'm fine, my dear. How is school?" she answers.
"School is good. I got an A in math!"
"Wonderful! I'm so proud of you."
We talk for thirty minutes about her garden and my friends.
Before I hang up, she always says, "I love you, and I miss you."

title: Help at the Library
content:
I went to the library to find a book about animals.
I couldn't find it on the shelf, so I asked the librarian.
"Excuse me, where are the animal books?" I asked politely.
"They are on the second floor, in section B," she said.
"Thank you! Can I borrow two books today?"
"Yes, you can borrow up to four books. Here is your card."
I was very happy and read all afternoon.

title: Weekend at the Beach
content:
Last weekend, my family went to the beach. The weather was sunny and hot.
We arrived at nine in the morning and put up a big umbrella.
I swam in the blue sea with my brother for an hour.
At noon, we ate sandwiches and watermelon under the umbrella.
In the afternoon, my sister built a sand castle.
We came home at six, tired but very happy.
It was a wonderful weekend.

title: Cooking with Mom
content:
On rainy Sundays, I love to cook with my mom.
Today we are making pasta with tomato sauce.
First, we boil water in a big pot. It takes ten minutes.
While waiting, Mom cuts onions and tomatoes.
I stir the sauce slowly so it doesn't burn.
At one o'clock, lunch is ready. The kitchen smells delicious.
My dad and brother love our cooking. They eat everything!

title: The Football Match
content:
Every Saturday afternoon, I play football with my team.
We wear red shirts. The other team wears blue.
The match starts at three o'clock. It lasts ninety minutes.
In the first half, we score two goals. The blue team scores one.
In the second half, I run fast and score the third goal!
My teammates cheer and hug me.
We win three to one. It was an amazing game.

title: Buying a Train Ticket
content:
I went to the train station to buy a ticket to London.
At the ticket office, I waited in line for ten minutes.
"Hello, one ticket to London, please," I said.
"Single or return?" asked the clerk.
"Return, please. How much is it?"
"Twenty-five pounds. The next train leaves at two thirty from platform six."
I paid with a card and thanked the clerk.
I bought a coffee and waited on the platform with my book.

title: At the Post Office
content:
This morning, I went to the post office to send a package to my cousin in Spain.
"Good morning. I'd like to send this package, please," I said.
"Of course. Can you put it on the scale?" said the clerk.
The package weighed two kilograms.
"How would you like to send it — standard or express?" she asked.
"Express, please. When will it arrive?"
"In three to five days. That will be eighteen euros."
I paid in cash and got the receipt.

title: Booking a Hotel
content:
My wife and I planned a holiday in Rome for our anniversary.
I called the Sunshine Hotel to book a room.
"Hello, I'd like to book a double room for three nights," I said.
"When would you like to come?" the receptionist asked.
"From the fifteenth to the eighteenth of June."
"We have a lovely room with a balcony for one hundred euros per night."
"That's perfect. Does the price include breakfast?"
"Yes, breakfast and free Wi-Fi are included."
I gave my name and credit card number. We were ready for Rome!
